title: EU Blue Card for the Czech Republic: a highly qualified job with gross pay of at least 1.5 times the average gross annual wage, CZK 885,870 a year from May 2026

sources.title: Aliens Act (No. 326/1999 Sb.), § 42i(1), (2) and (11)(b): a highly qualified job in the central register of vacancies open to Blue Card holders; a degree or equivalent skill
Aliens Act, § 42j(1)(b) to (d): a contract of 6 months or more, full time, with gross pay of at least 1.5 times the average gross annual wage the Ministry of Labour announces
Ministry of Labour communication No. 44/2026 Sb.: from the 2025 average, the average gross annual wage for Blue Cards is CZK 590,580 from 1 May 2026 to 30 April 2027
Decree No. 205/2023 Sb., §§ 1 and 2: for ICT managers and specialists (CZ-ISCO 133 and 25), 3 years of practice in the 7 years before applying counts as high qualification
Aliens Act, § 42a(1)(a) to (d) and (7)(d): a Blue Card holder's spouse, minor children and the spouse's, and a lone parent over 65 or a parent or child unable to care for themselves
Aliens Act, § 42b(1)(d): the family's total monthly income after reuniting must reach the members' subsistence minimums plus the housing amounts
Aliens Act, §§ 1(2), 1(3) and 87a and note 32: EU, EEA and Swiss citizens fall under the rules for EU citizens; the Blue Card is for third-country nationals (Directive 2021/1883)
Directive (EU) 2021/1883, arts. 2(1) and 3(2)(h): the Blue Card is for third-country nationals, not EU citizens, nor those with equal free movement rights by agreement
Employment Act (No. 435/2004 Sb.), § 3(2): EU citizens and their family members have the same legal position as Czech citizens in employment
Civil Code (No. 89/2012 Sb.), §§ 30(1) and 605(2): majority at 18; a period whose last month lacks the start day ends on that month's last day

requirements.title: Not a citizen of the Czech Republic, another EU or EEA state or Switzerland: they live and work there under the EU rules on free movement

assessments.title: A contract of 6 months or more, full time, for a highly qualified job in a vacancy listed as open to Blue Card holders, with gross pay of at least CZK 885,870 a year (1.5 × CZK 590,580)
A degree or higher vocational study from a programme of 3 years or more; for ICT managers and specialists, 3 years of practice in the last 7 years instead; a regulated profession needs recognition
For family members who come too: the family's total monthly income after reuniting reaches their subsistence minimums plus the housing amounts, or the housing costs shown

dependents.title: Children under 18; a child of 18 or more who depends on the principal: possible, if unable to care for themselves for health reasons
Parents 65 or more who live alone, read as having no spouse or partner; a parent who depends on the principal: possible, if unable to care for themselves for health reasons
